messages:
maria: Quick check — does anyone have ETA on vendor-supplied H100 slots for next Tues-Wed? Need to lock for demo pool (cost center: demos). Pinged acct rep but no reply. Also need a quota bump in project 'redwood-demo-asia'.

kevin: I saw a reply from the vendor yesterday — ETA ~48-72h but depends on rack staging. I'll DM the rep and cc procurement. :thumbsup:

lia: vendor_ops: we have 8 slots tentatively reserved pending PO. Need PO number + project tag + expected start date. Please fill the allocation form: https://proc.vendor/alloc?ref=redwood

maria: PO is in process — @sara can you confirm the PO number and whether we can ask for expedited staging?

sara: On it — submitted PO #PO-7842, requested expedited staging and added project tag 'redwood-demo'. Waiting on vendor confirmation; will update here when they ack. @kevin can you confirm the exact hardware spec we should lock?

kevin: We need H100 v3 (NVLink preferred) x8. Also we need a gcloud quota bump for GPUs in project 'redwood-demo-asia' — current quota shows 8 GPUs which would block provisioning.

maria: For the quota request I usually include this command output: ```gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-demo-asia``` and the body I sent vendor: ```{
  "project": "redwood-demo",
  "slots": 8,
  "start_date": "2025-04-08"
}```

procurement-bot: PO PO-7842 status changed to 'submitted' by sara — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PO-7842

tony: fyi @infra-oncall — if we get those 8 slots live we'll need a temp subnet + certs and a small change to the kube nodepool. tagging you so you can pre-provision.

infra-oncall: Noted. I'll pre-create vpc 'vpc-redwood-demo' and reserve IP ranges; ETA ~3 hours after PO is cleared. Also please open a tiny terraform PR for the accel request. Example snippet (swap type to h100):
```hcl
resource "google_compute_instance" "demo_gpu" {
  count = 8
  machine_type = "n1-standard-16"
  scheduling { preemptible = false }
  guest_accelerator {
    type  = "nvidia-tesla-h100"
    count = 1
  }
}
```

sara: Vendor replied — they can stage 6 units by Tue and the remaining 2 by Thu. Do we want a partial allocation (6 live now) or wait for all 8?

maria: Partial is fine — start canary with 6. We'll open the terraform PR for the 6 and follow up to add the other 2 when they arrive. Thanks everyone :party-popper:
